verdict_reason: The diff correctly drops the deleted contact controller's import and contract case with no remaining contact references, but the file carries Major code-quality findings on comments, alias names and one over-claiming test title.

todos.issue: Comments describe other modules and carry rationale: lines 69-70 (why ARRIVAL_DATE is derived from the window), 149-151 (how the reason page asks its questions), 377-378 (the shared picker serving 'all five spokes', a count), 420-422 (what the transporter list and add spokes declare).
todos.fix: Must: no comment in the file describes another module, carries rationale or counts; any rationale worth keeping lives in the repo's docs/ or the behaviour spec, and names (e.g. a helper like arrivalDateInsideWindow) say what the comments said. One way: delete the four comments and rename ARRIVAL_DATE / REASON_REVEALS if a name needs to carry the point.

todos.issue: Two aliases give existing values a second name: 'const drive = driveHandler' (line 67) and 'const committableKeys = obligationNames' (line 79, used once at line 82).
todos.fix: Must: each value has one name in the file. One way: call driveHandler directly and filter obligationNames in committedIds, deleting both aliases.

todos.issue: Title 'Should commit the same transporter answers from the add spokes the list declares them for' over-claims: the list declares transporterType, commercialTransporter and privateTransporter, but the assertions only show the chooser commits nothing and each details spoke commits its one party (transporterType is seeded, not committed); nothing compares against transporters.meta.collects.
todos.fix: Must: the title states what the assertions prove, or the assertions prove the title. One way: retitle to 'Should commit each typed-in transporter from its details spoke and nothing from the type chooser'.
